description: Emulates network, CPU, geolocation, user agent and colour scheme features on the selected page

colorScheme.description: Optional colour scheme to emulate: light, dark, or auto

cpuThrottlingRate.description: Optional CPU throttling rate; 1 means no throttling and the value must be at least 1

geolocation.description: Optional geolocation to emulate, given as a latitude and longitude pair

networkConditions.description: Optional network conditions preset to emulate, such as Slow 3G or Fast 3G

userAgent.description: Optional user agent string to emulate

name: emulate
